description: This file is a shell script for testing git stash show configuration options. It defines a testing framework and multiple tests to verify the behavior of the git stash show command with various settings for showStat and showPatch.

methods.name: test_stat_and_patch
methods.description: A function that configures git stash show options, creates a commit and a patch file, performs a stash, and compares the output of 'git stash show' against expected output based on the parameters.
